narrative:
## Handover Summary — Accruals & Flux Commentary

Accruals are posted and every material movement has reviewed commentary attached.

## Key Decisions
• GRNI accrual topped up for winter receipts not yet invoiced in Business Central
• Holiday pay (feriepenger) accrued on October onboarding of seasonal staff
• East shrink provision raised pending the store owners' recount

## Recommendation for Multi-Brand P&L
Watch Intersport gross margin. Higher shrink and aged summer stock both point to markdown pressure before the January sale.

signals.title: Winter season build — inbound plan
signals.excerpt: Alpine, cross-country and outerwear inbound peaks in October ahead of November and December trading. GRNI and rebate accruals are largest in this window.

signals.title: October cycle counts — East region
signals.excerpt: Four East stores report 1.8% shrink vs 1.1% budget, concentrated in electronics and ski goggles. Store owners asked to recount.
